name: 47-trpc-assert-request-id
title: Reorder checks in assertIsRequestId
body: Reorders the conditions in the request id assertion used by parseTRPCMessage so the numeric NaN check is evaluated before the string check.

bugs.why: The condition only throws when obj is a NaN number; booleans, objects, arrays and undefined short-circuit at `typeof obj === 'number'` and pass as valid request ids.
